NBA DFS Picks for Tuesday, October 20 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Tuesday, October 20 · 3 games · First game 3:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 20, 3:29 PM ET

Victor Wembanyama (SAS) is the top-projected player on the Tuesday, October 20 DraftKings main slate at 57.2 DraftKings points for $10,500. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 49.9, $10,200) and Jayson Tatum (BOS, 49.3, $9,000) are next.

OG Anunoby (NYK) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.19 projected points per $1,000 at $5,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 20, 3:29 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
